semantic_assertions.rationale: Canonical node ordering places the single lowered capability node first.
Only capability success and failure are normal named exits.
Engine error and cancellation semantics are bound by the versioned lowering contract.
The exact lowering contract identity is part of the conformance result.
Definition state, lowered node, and bound Capability use one execution kind.
Capability dispatch binds one exact Published Adapter identity.
The Adapter Registry content hash is part of the immutable Plan binding.
Capability dispatch binds one exact finite Delivery Policy identity.
T5 persists this exact effective Policy snapshot as an immutable Value.
Planner cannot choose the Capability dispatch lane.
The reconciliation mode is fixed by the Published Capability.
The Adapter idempotency contract is immutable execution input.
Capability dispatch failure remains coupled to Attempt outcome.
The lowered failure route terminates through a first-class Terminal Node.
The lowered success route terminates through a first-class Terminal Node.
Succeeded and failed capability facts have distinct terminal routes.
Join expose is lowered from the compiled input contract.
The generated schema carries content-addressed identity.
The generated schema carries canonical resolvable content.
The downstream edge is proven against the lowered join output.
Canonical node ordering and the exact wait contract are explicit Plan facts.
The required Wait correlation port has a typed data binding.
Static subgraph binding requires an exact precompiled child Plan hash.
The structural owner freezes its declared completion/result port as a generated typed output.
Nodes are sorted by id and Expand consumes the required GraphScopeSpec port.
The literal candidate implements the pinned child interface and is child-compiled.
The structural owner freezes its declared completion/result port as a generated typed output.
Map result order is an explicit execution field in Compiled IR v2.
The structural owner freezes its declared completion/result port as a generated typed output.
Requested limit tightens the parent and Safety ceilings.
Canonical node ordering preserves the exact feedback schema binding.
The Plan stores the sound proof rule for different schema hashes.
Parent-before-child canonical closure ordering lists the nested child first.
The transitive inline leaf is a hashed closure member in Compiled IR v2.
